verdict.rationale: All MCP evidence (apify-docs-10, apify-probe-3) describes Apify exposing its own Actors via an MCP server so external AI agents can use Apify's tools — i.e., Apify acting as an MCP server provider, not as a client that plugs in third-party MCP servers to use their tools. There is no evidence Apify can consume or integrate external MCP servers itself, so the story as stated (product acting as MCP client) is unsupported.
